scope: Optimistic synthetic six-source continuous tracking with every true voice seeded once; no note-acquisition, real-guitar or musical-readiness proof
seed_contract: Every true voice receives exact initial identity/pitch before motion; model must learn phase and spectral profiles normally. Public IDs equal tracker slots. Physical strings are independently permuted onto slots and never rematched for scoring.
timing_contract: Compare every estimate with current true pitch at actual observation end, including motion onsets/reversals and all model delay; no backdating, future interpolation, fitted delay alignment or nearest-voice error rescue.
missing_data_contract: A missing true voice is a failure, reported separately and never counted as an accurate pitch sample. Aggregate passing requires complete identity coverage plus all pitch checks.
challenge_interpretation: Weak/overlapping/stiff partials can limit identifiability; retain failures and phase-observability reports without making a universal impossibility or readiness claim.
